name: footer-slim
title: Footer Slim
description: A one-row footer for apps and docs: wordmark, links, a light, dark and system switch and the copyright line.

props.name: brand
props.description: The wordmark or logo, rendered as given.

props.name: links
props.description: Inline links: docs, status, privacy. Keep to about five.

props.name: theme
props.description: The current theme choice. The switch only shows when `onThemeChange` is also given.

props.name: onThemeChange
props.description: Called with the picked theme. Apply it to your app yourself; this footer never touches the DOM.

props.name: now
props.description: Pins the © year and keeps the first render pure. When absent the year appears after mount.

a11y.text: A footer with a nav (default "Footer") list that shows only when there are links. The theme switch is Pills from chart-kit (label "Theme": Light, Dark, System) and only shows when both theme and onThemeChange are passed. External links carry a hidden new tab text.
Pills arrows move between theme options, with Home and End.
The switch's thumb slides between options; under reduced motion it jumps.
